Hi Maya — happy to outline the practical steps. High-level marketplace + billing path for AWS Private Offers: 

1) Redwood creates a Private Offer in the AWS Marketplace tied to deal ORB-2026-1423.
2) OrbitEdge confirms acceptance in the marketplace console (or we can send a DocuSign + AWS acceptance flow).
3) Once accepted, AWS issues the invoice to the buyer based on the PO line item. Redwood receives payment from AWS according to our marketplace payout terms.
4) Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears (net 30) unless a different cadence is specified on the PO.

Suggested Mutual Action Agenda (dates shown are recommended if we target Oct 6 close):
- By Sep 20: Finance confirms vendor billing address + ERP fields (procurement@orbitedge.ai) — owner: OrbitEdge
- By Sep 22: Redwood sends DocuSign agreement + AWS Private Offer prep — owner: Redwood (Jordan/Rohan)
- Sep 23–28: Legal reviews and redlines (OrbitEdge legal)
- Sep 29: Final signatures and AWS Private Offer acceptance
- Oct 4–6: Technical acceptance window (Grace to run smoke tests)

SOC2: Rohan — I uploaded the most recent SOC 2 Type II report to the shared drive and attached the Marketplace playbook (aws-private-offer-playbook.pdf) for OrbitEdge to map to procurement requirements.

If the dates above look tight I can slide Acceptance to Oct 13, but aiming for Oct 6 is doable if legal moves quickly.

Regards,
